mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during easing cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate decline below 4.5% indicates labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.5% within the last 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate rise above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns during tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates sustained economic expansion that supports corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth in the prior quarter fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 200.0 indicates accelerating inflation that triggers Fed rate hikes, reducing equity market returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 200.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline signal labor market strength that increases household income and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in PAYEMS and decrease in UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, HOUST exceeding 2100.0 units signals continued economic momentum that sustains corporate growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST exceeds 2100.0 during late-cycle expansion.
